question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

196 : 226 :: 256 : 290 :: 324 : ?
solution:
**Logic : (Square root of 1st number) + 1 = Square root of (2nd number - 1) **

So,

__
 
• 196 : 226

​ sqrt{196} + 1 = sqrt{(226 - 1)} 

14 + 1 = sqrt{225}

15 = 15 (LHS = RHS)

And,

 
• 256 : 290

​ sqrt{256} + 1 = sqrt{(290 - 1)} 

16 + 1 = sqrt{289}

17 = 17 (LHS = RHS)17 = 17

Similarly,

 
• 324 : ?

​ sqrt{324} + 1 = sqrt{(x - 1)} 

18 + 1 = sqrt{x - 1}

(19)² = x - 1

361 + 1 = x 

**x = 362**

Hence, **"362"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **Alternate Method__**

 
• 196:226 = 14² : (15²+1)
 
• 256:290 = 16² : (17²+1)
 
• Similarly,
 
• 324:362 = 18² : (19²+1)

Hence, "362" is the correct answer.
